{{Top|leg}}
A '''larynx''' was a part of a [[Human/Legends|Human's]] anatomy which was located in the [[Throat/Legends|throat]], functioning as the '''voice box'''. Each Human had only a single larynx. When an individual was [[Telekinesis/Legends#Choking powers|Force choked]], damage was sometimes done to the larynx, which could be [[Death/Legends|fatal]].

One part of [[Crozo Industrial Products/Legends|Crozo Industrial Products']] [[At-cyb husher mike]] was surgically implanted into an individual's throat near the larynx. The vocalizer implant transmitted subvocalized messages, translating the movements of the individual's jaw, [[Tongue/Legends|tongue]], and vocal cords.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
